title: Pyramiddle is looking for more Word Nerds
author: JFCG4mer
selftext:
The AI content generation roots are pretty evident when you get a chance play, but I've had an absolute blast making this (both the backend service and iOS and Android apps). 

\-- [https://pyramiddlegame.com](https://pyramiddlegame.com) \-- (iOS and Android store links)  
  
I'm looking for more players to help me with some gameplay feedback.

AI Background:  
\- Almost entirely Claude Code to create the Godot scripts and dev tools   
\- Google Gemini (Nano Banana) for assets   
\- Supabase backend with a REST API

Again, feedback is encouraged and appreciated!
